jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(E) inventory: Newport Town School District, a town school district in the North Country Supervisory Union (member town: Newport Town). Operates Newport Town School. Distinct from the Newport City School District.
North Country SU Newport Town School Board page (official).

sources.note: Newport Town School District: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b) (the section 423(b) expansion vote record itself was not fetched; the five-member board rests on the SU's published rosters across five consecutive school years). No term expirations are published. North Country SU Newport Town School Board page (official): rosters by school year 2022-2023 through 2026-2027, five members every year (2026-2027: Cameron Thompson, Chair; Jill Raymond, Vice Chair; Dari Joi Glover, Treasurer; Heather LeBlanc; Tina Royer). The 2025-2026 roster has Reene Fontaine in LeBlanc's place. No term expirations are published for any member.
